operationalContext.interpretation: These offline numeric false positives are real validator blockers if left unresolved. They do not prove why the live review timed out, and clearing them would not by itself establish successful grounding, delivery or deadline compliance.

independence.semanticJudgments: Independent manual assessment of all 24 reproduced flagged units, using the previously sealed ground truth. Counterfactual detector results are supporting diagnostics, not substitutes for semantic review.

reproduction.loader: An in-memory loadModules loader evaluates only the compiled CommonJS strings in plan.modules.candidate. Every module string is SHA-256 checked against plan.moduleHashes.candidate. Non-snapshot imports are rejected.
reproduction.numericInspection: The exact label and numbers helper definitions are extracted from the frozen factual-grounding module into an offline VM to enumerate unmatched numerals. No number-extraction fix is substituted.
reproduction.counterfactual: For each flagged unit, remove only the explicitly recorded structural annotations in an ephemeral string, retain factual words and numbers, and rerun the unmodified frozen deterministicIssues. No modified draft is written or treated as a candidate result.
reproduction.generatedCountVerification: Titles describing three captions, eight hooks and five CTAs are checked against actual caption headings or item counts in their generated sections.
reproduction.noRepairValidationClaim: This checks the cause of the 24 missing_evidence flags only. It does not certify that a repaired draft passes the full parseGroundingReview semantic/reference validator.

summary.semanticIssuesElsewhere: Not re-adjudicated in this artifact; the frozen independent audit remains authoritative for its broader content judgments.
summary.verdict: All 24 reproduced numeric missing_evidence findings are format-annotation false positives, not unsupported business-fact numbers.

findings: The anchored prefix recognizer does not recognize thread numbering such as 1/.
Nested Carousel: Slide N: wrappers and pipe-prefixed Slide N:/Beat N: markers are not recognized at the start of the numeric scan.
Plural/count-bearing section titles such as captions (3), Hooks: 8 and CTAs: 5 are generated-format descriptors, not source facts.
Numbers appearing elsewhere in source text can accidentally prevent a format flag, so the absence of flags on other ordinal values is not evidence that those values are semantically grounded.
mechanism.validatorConsequence: parseGroundingReview rejects every non-unsupported decision when deterministicIssues(unit.text, context) remains nonempty. Merely labeling one of these units structural, subjective, creative or supported cannot bypass the frozen numeric flag.
mechanism.mixedUnitCaution: Most affected units are not wholly structural: they mix a format annotation with factual or advisory copy. Classifying the entire sentence as structural would be wrong. The specific numeric complaint is false while dates, prices, duration, coverage and verification scope still require ordinary grounding.

boundedRecommendations: Scope any format-number exception to the known section type, field path and recognized structural span; do not globally ignore numerals or entire titles.
Recognize ordinal wrappers without suppressing substantive numbers in the same span: e.g. thread index versus release 2.6; slide index versus 8 of 12 pages; beat index versus 25 minutes or EUR 18.
Verify generated option-count titles against their actual section contents, not against unrelated source numbers.
Keep semantic review, offer boundaries, No-CTA checks and factual evidence validation active on the non-annotation text.

Validate any proposed parser fix separately with genuine unsupported prices/durations/outcome counts as negative controls and the mixed units documented here. This audit has not inspected or approved Meitner's fix.
limitations: This is a deliberately bounded audit of 24 reproduced flags from three raw drafts, not a general false-positive rate estimate.
The removal-only counterfactual is a diagnostic and is not a production implementation or an approved textual repair.
No paid rerun, completed review, successful delivery, latency improvement or deploy readiness is established by this artifact.
